text: Provides reproducible development environments
quote: Reproducible development environments

text: nix-shell builds or downloads a project's declared dependencies and opens a Bash shell with all needed environment variables set
quote: the command `nix-shell` will build or download those dependencies if they’re not already in your Nix store, and then start a Bash shell in which all necessary environment variables (such as compiler search paths) are set.

text: nix develop opens a bash shell that provides the build environment of a derivation
quote: `nix develop` - run a bash shell that provides the build environment of a derivation

text: Individual installed packages can be upgraded from the command line with nix-env --upgrade
quote:
$ nix-env --upgrade --attr nixpkgs.some-package
$ nix-env --rollback

text: Old versions remain after an upgrade, so users can roll back to a previous version with nix-env --rollback
quote:
you can roll back to the old version:
$ nix-env --rollback

text: Multiple versions or variants of the same package can be installed side by side
quote: You can have multiple versions or variants of a package installed at the same time. This is especially important when different applications have dependencies on different versions of the same package

text: A garbage collector safely deletes unused packages
quote: unused packages can be deleted safely by running the _garbage collector_

text: The entire NixOS system configuration can be rolled back to an earlier state
quote: it is easy to roll back the entire configuration of the system to an earlier state

text: Package operations are atomic because new versions go to new store paths instead of overwriting existing ones
quote: Since package management operations never overwrite packages in the Nix store but just add new versions in different paths, they are atomic.

text: Installing or upgrading one package cannot break other packages
quote: Nix ensures that installing or upgrading one package cannot break other packages.

text: First-class support for cross compilation
quote: First-class cross compilation support.

text: Reproducible integration testing using virtual machines
quote: Reproducible integration testing using virtual machines.

text: Multi-user (daemon) installation through a single curl install script
quote: $ curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -L https://nixos.org/nix/install | sh -s -- --daemon

text: A NixOS live CD lets users try NixOS and Nix without installing
quote: It's a live CD, so it allows you to get an impression of NixOS (and the Nix package manager) without installing it.

text: Over 140,000 packages are available to install
quote: Choose from over 140 000 Packages

text: Users can create a new flake with nix flake new and build it with nix build
quote: Create a new flake: # nix flake new hello ... Build the flake in the current directory: # nix build

text: NixOS systems are configured declaratively in /etc/nixos/configuration.nix
quote: You configure a NixOS system by writing a specification of the functionality that you want on your machine in `/etc/nixos/configuration.nix`.

text: The whole OS, including kernel, apps, packages and config files, is built by Nix from a purely functional description
quote: In NixOS, the entire operating system — the kernel, applications, system packages, configuration files, and so on — is built by the Nix package manager from a description in a purely functional build language.

text: Building system configurations from Nix expressions keeps configurations from overwriting each other
quote: By building entire system configurations from a Nix expression, NixOS ensures that such configurations don’t overwrite each other, can be rolled back, and so on.

text: Software can be installed easily over URLs
quote: Easy installation of software over URLs.

text: Non-privileged users can securely install software, and each user can have their own profile
quote: non-privileged users can securely install software. Each user can have a different _profile_

text: Supports remote builds and remote deployments
quote: Remote builds. Remote deployments.

text: nix search command searches for packages
quote: `nix search` - search for packages

text: Automatically uses a binary cache of pre-built binaries instead of building from source
quote: Nix can automatically skip building from source and instead use a binary cache, a web server that provides pre-built binaries.

text: NixOS can be installed on physical hardware from CD/DVD images
quote: You can install NixOS on physical hardware by burning one of the CD images onto a blank CD/DVD disk

text: Graphical installer ISO includes the NixOS installer, several desktop environments and applications
quote: The graphical installation ISO image contains the graphical NixOS installer as well as several Desktop Environments and several applications.

text: nix run runs a Nix application directly
quote: `nix run` - run a Nix application

text: NixOS can be deployed to Amazon EC2 using an official AMI
quote: NixOS can be deployed to Amazon EC2 using our official AMI.

text: Can build minimal Docker images
quote: Minimal docker images

text: Official Docker image (nixos/nix) provides a shell with Nix preinstalled
quote: Start a Docker shell with Nix: $ docker run -it nixos/nix

text: Software environments can be easily transferred between computers
quote: Easy transfer of software environments between computers.

text: Development and build environments can be shared for projects regardless of language or tooling
quote: Nix makes it trivial to share development and build environments for your projects, regardless of what programming languages and tools you're using.

text: A package that works on one machine will also work on another
quote: if a package works on one machine, it will also work on another.

text: Builds only see resources explicitly declared as dependencies
quote: Under Nix, a build process will only find resources that have been declared explicitly as dependencies.

text: Nix expressions can be turned into functions and called with different arguments to produce package variants
quote: turn the Nix expression into a function and call it any number of times with the appropriate arguments.

text: A laptop or a fleet of servers can be described in reversible, repeatable configuration
quote: Describe a laptop or a fleet of servers in reversable and repeatable configuration.

text: nix bundle packages an application so it works outside the Nix store
quote: `nix bundle` - bundle an application so that it works outside of the Nix store

text: nix why-depends shows why a package has another package in its closure
quote: `nix why-depends` - show why a package has another package in its closure

text: nix repl provides an interactive environment for evaluating Nix expressions
quote: `nix repl` - start an interactive environment for evaluating Nix expressions

text: Runs on Linux and macOS alongside the existing package manager
quote: Runs on Linux and macOS, next to the package manager you already have.
